verdict.rationale: Gazebo Fuel is explicitly referenced as a registry/ecosystem for accessing numerous ready-made robot models (PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create, TurtleBot) and environment models, and docs show pulling SDF snippets from model pages into custom files, directly matching the 'pull reusable hardware packages' story. missing for 10: no evidence of a browsable/searchable Fuel catalog UI details, versioning, or independent hands-on confirmation of the workflow's reliability.
